name: Bento: hero plus three
description: A wide hero card carries the summary; three cards below each take one item. Four equal cards would lose the summary-then-detail hierarchy.

title.hint: a one-line claim, up to 24 characters

hero.hint: summary: 1 to 3 lines, or a list of up to 3 items

card-1.hint: card one: a short phrase or a big number

card-3.hint: card three; leave empty when not needed

brand.value: Confirm the story before the slides

title.value: Sign off the story before any layout

hero.value: Brief -> story file (you confirm) -> visual direction -> generate -> edit in the browser. The only step where a person has to stop is confirming the story.

card-2.label: visual directions, each a real cover

card-3.value: Edits after generation happen only in the browser; regenerating keeps them.
